context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly handles a do_not_proceed_for_now verdict: grounding, correct verdict value, a concrete revisit trigger, schema validation, and recording as a known-issue rather than a finding.

checklist.name: Grounds before assigning roles
checklist.description: Uses the supplied facts (GSI count, write volume, no team experience) rather than assuming

checklist.name: Migration/Risk role included
checklist.description: Migration/Risk role assigned given the subject is a database migration

checklist.name: Correct verdict value
checklist.description: Verdict is do_not_proceed_for_now given the facts, not proceed or a hedge

checklist.name: Concrete revisit trigger
checklist.description: A specific, checkable revisit condition is named, not 'revisit later'

checklist.name: Schema validation run
checklist.description: The verdict is validated against the debate-verdict schema before finalizing

checklist.name: Validation confirms revisit trigger
checklist.description: The validation step is used to confirm the revisit trigger is actually present

checklist.name: Recorded as known-issue
checklist.description: Outcome recorded via context-file as a KNOWN_ISSUE, not a finding

checklist.name: Revisit trigger becomes fix condition
checklist.description: The known-issue's fix condition is the same revisit trigger from the verdict

checklist.name: Explicit persistence ask
checklist.description: User is asked explicitly before the known-issue is written
